algorithm.distribution: Distribute lightness evenly from maxL to minL.
algorithm.chromaClamp: Clamp chroma per step using max chroma for that lightness, hue, and color space.
algorithm.extremeBehavior: High-chroma colors lose chroma at very light and dark extremes; this is correct.

multiHuePalettes.rule: Use same L and same chroma percentage across hues.
multiHuePalettes.avoid: Do not use the same absolute chroma for every hue.

darkMode.rule: Reverse/match token mapping instead of random dark colors.
